method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; a seat-neutral core (ohsr-core.l4), date helpers (ohsr-dates.l4, prelude only, no daydate import, no YMD) and a seat layer (ohsr-seat.l4) that restates no rule; one ranked order of control serving nine Parts; three regulative rules (r 195(1), r 200(1), r 355(1)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; the parent Act's penalties (ss 21, 22(1)) and reach (s 21(3)) restated narrowly with the section; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
